verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are purpose-built for programmatic, agent-driven lifecycle: create ephemeral isolated environments via SDK, execute commands, access filesystem for results, and tear down, all API-driven without human intervention (docs on sandbox creation, running commands, filesystem access, networking, snapshots). Community evidence confirms real agent/automation use cases (self-hosted CI runners, JS agent runtime controlling sandboxes via gRPC), though full read-and-teardown loop is inferred from docs rather than an explicit end-to-end demo.
